row.notes: Race-strategy helper: sums planned laps over the stint vector plan+8..+0x10 (0x38-byte stints: +0 compound id, +4 laps done, +8 flag -1 = open stint, +0xc planned laps, +0x14, +0x24 tyre variant) and while the total exceeds vehCtx+0x234 (laps available) it scores each trimmable stint by integrating a time/wear cost of its last lap (Car_Tyre_SampleCurveSet2KeyLerp, Car_Tyre_SampleWearCurve2DAlt, Sess_VpTable_SelectBlocks, compound tables 0x14585bc48/0x14585bc9c, factors 0.33/0.66 for compounds 3/4, g_Game_TrackLength, g_Live_SectorEnds[3]) and decrements +0xc of the highest-scoring stint. Uses vehCtx+0xc4 car index, +0x1e4 per-compound wear scale, +0x240 and flag +0x26b bit 0x10 as a lap reserve; sentinel 1e38 (0x7e967699) marks scores to recompute. Good hook for AI/suggested pit strategy stint lengths. Better context needed: caller to confirm AI vs player strategy.
